0.original: Momodi of the Quicksand has word of work for a willing adventurer.

1.original: Momodi informs you that Dadanen, a merchant who deals in precious stones, is seeking the aid of an able adventurer. Travel to the settlement of Horizon in western Thanalan and see what work he offers.

2.original: Dadanen tells you that Horizon's role as a center for trade means there is always work to be found. Look around the settlement and see what it has to offer.

48.original: Look what the coeurl dragged in. Good to see you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'd ask what brings you, but I reckon we both know the answer to that already.

49.original: Well, have I ever let you down before? Wait, don't answer that...

50.original: So happens I know a fella by the name of Dadanen who needs a hand. He's a merchant by trade, sellin' precious stones to those in Ul'dah with the means to buy them.

51.original: He's asked that I send any lookin' for work his way. You can find him over in Horizon, if you fancy.

52.original: That's in western Thanalan, mind you. Just cross the bridge north of Scorpion Crossing and the road will take you there.

53.original: Knowin' the circles he deals in, might be he'll have some talk of the royal family that'll interest you, as well.

54.original: And why not make use of a chocobo porter for the journey to Horizon? If you've the gil for it, that is.

55.original: You'll find the chocobo stables just across the way from my Quicksand. Find Mimigun─he'll set you straight.

56.original: Well, off you go, then. I haven't got all day to be holdin' your bloody hand!

57.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I presume? Aye, Momodi said to expect you, and so I have.

58.original: Welcome to Horizon. Ours is a trading settlement that sees goods in from the port of Vesper Bay to the west─and trade we do. Nary a day goes by that Horizon isn't bustling with some manner of merchants and officials.

59.original: They keep us running about busy, they do. Enough so that I wish I had chocobo legs in place of my own. And that's why I've asked Momodi to send me any souls looking for work.

60.original: Twelve know there is plenty of it to be done around here. Speak to me again when you are ready to make yourself of some use.
